name: io.github.ertad-family/liquid
title: Liquid
description: Connect your AI agent to anything — APIs, databases, and agents; read and write, auto-discovered.

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI (or compatible) API key for discovery

environmentVariables.name: OPENAI_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. local Ollama/vLLM

environmentVariables.name: LIQUID_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the write tools: liquid_execute (database insert/update/delete) and liquid_request (form, multipart file-upload and raw binary bodies to HTTP APIs). Off by default — read-only.

environmentVariables.name: LIQUID_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Directories liquid_request may read upload files from (os.pathsep-separated). Default: ~/.liquid/uploads. Paths outside are refused.

environmentVariables.name: LIQUID_MAX_BODY_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum size of an uploaded request body in bytes. Default: 26214400 (25 MiB).
